# load data

```{r, echo=FALSE}


library(here)      
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)

path_data <- function(file) {
  here("01_data", file)
}

SUBSET_BDI    <- read.xlsx(path_data("SUBSET_BDI.xlsx"))    %>% unique()
SUBSET_CESD   <- read.xlsx(path_data("SUBSET_CESD.xlsx"))   %>% unique()
SUBSET_HADS   <- read.xlsx(path_data("SUBSET_HADS.xlsx"))   %>% unique()
SUBSET_PHQ    <- read.xlsx(path_data("SUBSET_PHQ.xlsx"))    %>% unique()
SUBSET_PROMIS <- read.xlsx(path_data("SUBSET_PROMIS.xlsx")) %>% unique()


```

# Datensätze erstellen (Felix)

In drei Schritten results Liste mit "Study", "Variable", "measure_1", "measure_2", "value_1", "value_2", "groupsize" aus allen Fragebogenkombinationen erstellen

```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(Hmisc)

BDIxCESD = inner_join(SUBSET_BDI, SUBSET_CESD, by = c("Study", "Variable")) %>% unique()
BDIxHADS <- inner_join(SUBSET_BDI, SUBSET_HADS, by = c("Study", "Variable")) %>%unique()
BDIxPHQ <- inner_join(SUBSET_BDI, SUBSET_PHQ, by = c("Study", "Variable")) %>%unique()
BDIxPROMIS <- inner_join(SUBSET_BDI, SUBSET_PROMIS, by = c("Study", "Variable")) %>%unique()
CESDxHADS <- inner_join(SUBSET_CESD, SUBSET_HADS, by = c("Study", "Variable")) %>%unique()
CESDxPHQ <- inner_join(SUBSET_CESD, SUBSET_PHQ, by = c("Study", "Variable")) %>%unique()
CESDxPROMIS <- inner_join(SUBSET_CESD, SUBSET_PROMIS, by = c("Study", "Variable")) %>%unique()
HADSxPHQ <- inner_join(SUBSET_HADS, SUBSET_PHQ, by = c("Study", "Variable")) %>%unique()
HADSxPROMIS <- inner_join(SUBSET_HADS, SUBSET_PROMIS, by = c("Study", "Variable")) %>%unique()
PHQxPROMIS <- inner_join(SUBSET_PHQ, SUBSET_PROMIS, by = c("Study", "Variable"))%>%unique()


results = list(BDIxCESD, BDIxHADS, BDIxPHQ, 
BDIxPROMIS, CESDxHADS, CESDxPHQ, CESDxPROMIS, HADSxPHQ, 
HADSxPROMIS, PHQxPROMIS)
names(results) =  c("BDIxCESD", "BDIxHADS", "BDIxPHQ", 
"BDIxPROMIS", "CESDxHADS", "CESDxPHQ", "CESDxPROMIS", "HADSxPHQ", 
"HADSxPROMIS", "PHQxPROMIS")

results$BDIxPROMIS$PROMIS_PROMIS.Skala = results$BDIxPROMIS$PROMIS

results2 = lapply(names(results), function(x){
results[[x]]$measure_1 = strsplit(x, "x")[[1]][1]
results[[x]]$measure_2 = strsplit(x, "x")[[1]][2]
results[[x]]$value_1 = results[[x]][, grep("PROMIS", names(results[[x]]))[1]]
results[[x]]$value_2 =  results[[x]][, grep("PROMIS", names(results[[x]]))[2]]
results[[x]]$groupsize = results[[x]][,"groupsize.x"]
results[[x]][, c("Study", "Variable", "measure_1", "measure_2", "value_1", "value_2", "groupsize")]
})

str(results2)
results3 = bind_rows(results2)
results3$groupsize = as.numeric(results3$groupsize)

```


# Figure 2: Blant Altman plot

```{r, echo=FALSE}
results3$m = (results3$value_1 + results3$value_2)/2
results3$d = (results3$value_1 - results3$value_2)
results4 = results3 %>% group_by(measure_1, measure_2) %>% summarise(mean1 = mean(d), wgt_mean = wtd.mean(d, w = groupsize, na.rm = T),
                                                                     sd = sd(d), wtd_sd = sqrt(wtd.var(d, w = groupsize)),
                                                                     lo = mean1-1.96*sd, hi = mean1+1.96*sd,
                                                                     wtd_lo = wgt_mean-1.96*wtd_sd, wtd_hi = wgt_mean+1.96*wtd_sd)


counts <- results3 %>%
  dplyr::count(measure_1, measure_2, name = "n")

Weighted <- ggplot(results3, aes(x = m, y = d)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) + 
  facet_grid(measure_1 ~ measure_2) +

  # Horizontale Linien
  geom_hline(data = results4, aes(yintercept = wgt_mean)) + 
  geom_hline(data = results4, aes(yintercept = wtd_lo), linetype = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(data = results4, aes(yintercept = wtd_hi), linetype = 2, alpha = 0.5) +

  # Beschriftungen mittig über den Linien
geom_text(data = results4, 
          aes(x = 50, y = wtd_lo, label = sprintf("%.1f", wtd_lo)), 
          vjust = 0.2, hjust = 2.9, color = "black", size = 4.5) +  
  geom_text(data = results4, 
            aes(x = 50, y = wtd_hi, label = sprintf("%.1f", wtd_hi)), 
            vjust = 0.8, hjust = 2.1, color = "black", size = 4.5) + 
  geom_text(data = results4, 
            aes(x = 50, y = wgt_mean, label = sprintf("%.1f", wgt_mean)), 
            vjust = 0.8, hjust = -1.9, color = "black", size = 4.5) +

  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(30, 70), ylim = c(-15, 15)) +
  labs(
    
    x = "PROMIS T-Score", 
    y = "Difference (d)"
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"), 
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 16),        
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),               
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),                  
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14), 
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14) 
  )


Weighted

ggsave("Figure_2.jpeg", plot = Weighted, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)


```

# Figure 3: Difference vs. Group size

```{r, echo=FALSE}
d_groupsize <- ggplot(results3, aes(x = groupsize, y = d)) +
  geom_point() +  
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "blue") + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = -1, ymax = 1, xmin = 0, xmax = 1000), fill = "grey", alpha = .2) +  
  labs(
    x = "Group Size",
    y = "Difference (d)",
  ) +
  scale_x_log10() + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-20, 20)) +  
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "D") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),    
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 20),               
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),               
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),              
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),            
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),                
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 12)              
  )
d_groupsize

ggsave("Figure_3.jpeg", plot = d_groupsize, width = 10, height = 8, units = "in")


```



```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Convert lmme to data frame
df <- lmme %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename(
    Comparison_base = questionnaire_pair,
    Estimate = emmean,
    lo = lower.CL,
    hi = upper.CL
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    t_value = Estimate / SE,
    p_value = 2 * pt(abs(t_value), df = df, lower.tail = FALSE)
  )


study_counts <- c(
  "BDI CESD"    = 7,
  "BDI HADS"    = 9,
  "BDI PHQ"     = 20,
  "BDI PROMIS"  = 1,
  "CESD HADS"   = 14,
  "CESD PHQ"    = 9,
  "CESD PROMIS" = 1,
  "HADS PHQ"    = 19,
  "HADS PROMIS" = 1,
  "PHQ PROMIS"  = 6
)

group_counts <- c(
  "BDI CESD"    = 23,
  "BDI HADS"    = 32,
  "BDI PHQ"     = 38,
  "BDI PROMIS"  = 2,
  "CESD HADS"   = 36,
  "CESD PHQ"    = 27,
  "CESD PROMIS" = 1,
  "HADS PHQ"    = 38,
  "HADS PROMIS" = 1,
  "PHQ PROMIS"  = 6
)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    est_lbl = sprintf("%.2f", Estimate),
    ci_lbl  = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", lo, hi),
    p_lbl   = ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p_value)),
    study_n = study_counts[Comparison_base],
    group_n = group_counts[Comparison_base],
    Comparison = sprintf("%s (studies n=%d, groups n=%d)",
                         Comparison_base, study_n, group_n)
  )

df <- df[order(df$Estimate), ]
df$Comparison <- factor(df$Comparison, levels = df$Comparison)

# Dynamic spacing
x_data_max <- max(c(df$Estimate, df$hi))
x_data_min <- min(c(df$Estimate, df$lo))
rng <- x_data_max - x_data_min
gap <- rng * 0.40

x_col1 <- x_data_max + gap * 1.0
x_col2 <- x_col1    + gap * 1.25
x_col3 <- x_col2    + gap * 0.9
x_max  <- x_col3 + gap * 0.8
x_min  <- x_data_min - gap * 0.30


# Final plot
figure_4 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Estimate, y = Comparison)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi),
                 height = 0.26, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 4.6, shape = 21, fill = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +

  geom_text(aes(x = x_col1, label = est_lbl), hjust = 0, size = 7) +
  geom_text(aes(x = x_col2, label = ci_lbl),  hjust = 0, size = 7) +
  geom_text(aes(x = x_col3, label = p_lbl),   hjust = 0, size = 7) +

  annotate("text", x = x_col1, y = Inf, label = "Estimate",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.4, fontface = "bold", size = 6) +
  annotate("text", x = x_col2, y = Inf, label = "95% CI",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.4, fontface = "bold", size = 6) +
  annotate("text", x = x_col3, y = Inf, label = "p-value",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.4, fontface = "bold", size = 6) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(x_min, x_max),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18)

figure_4

# optional speichern
ggsave("figure_4.jpeg", plot = figure_4,
       width = 24, height = 9, units = "in", dpi = 300)





```
